REVIEW: BLOCKED
Reviewed-SHA: df06dfcd31758400a9bc82e625cb0ceb0f272bdd

Local run at this head: `npm test` 898/898 passed, `npm run check` passed, `npm run build` passed. The hosted `test` check is green on this head.

Findings:
1. **Merge conflict with main (blocking).** Merging into current `main` (6ab5d80) conflicts in `contracts/carr-interface.v1.json`, `tours/app.js`, and the pin assertions in `test/charts.test.mjs`, `test/conversations.test.mjs`, `test/model-room.test.mjs`, `test/notifications.test.mjs`, `test/search.test.mjs` and `test/sessions.test.mjs`. Fix: merge `main`, then re-pin (see 2).
2. `contracts/carr-interface.v1.json:3-6`. The producer pin moves to `a7c7df19…`, but `version` stays at `1.31.0` even though the app now depends on a new server read (`/api/tours/property-evidence/v1`). Main is already at `1.33.0` / `c4f1ad45…`. Fix: pin a carr-system commit that contains both main's producer changes and the property-evidence read, and bump the minor version per the repo's additive-change convention. Confirm the pinned commit is on carr-system `main` (merged PR #1400), not an unmerged branch head.
3. `tours/property-panel.js:103-106` (`mountPropertyPanel`). `renderTour()` runs after every stop reorder or save and rebuilds the panel. The property selection is restored, but the As-of date input is reset to today and the evidence is refetched each time, so a partner's historical as-of view is silently replaced. Fix: carry the prior date value across remounts the same way `prior` carries the selection, and skip the refetch when property and date are unchanged.
4. `tours/property-panel.js:104,114`. "Today" is computed from the UTC date (`toISOString().slice(0,10)`). In the evening in US time zones, the default date is tomorrow. Fix: derive the default and the "is today" comparison from the local date.

Clean: escaping covers values, locators and option labels (the hostile-input test passes); only `https:` locators become links; unknown, unavailable and conflicting states read "Unknown" and never pick a winner; "Context only" framing is kept; the diagram scrolls inside its card at 390px; reduced motion is honored.
